Description: A crypto company office places a dark wood desk under the window with three monitors and a mechanical keyboard in front. Three black GPUs sit to the right of the keyboard while a small golden pig statue rests on the desk near them. A black gaming chair faces the desk. Nearby, a round glass meeting table sits beside the door with two white notepads and two black pens on them. Against the far wall stands a side table with two hardware wallets on top and above it hangs a neon bitcoin sign; a tall server rack sits against the wall near the door.
